fact_text: The KSE-100 dropped about 3,000 points on 6 Mar 2026, after government institutions had supported the market for two sessions earlier that week.

fact_text: Market leverage has fallen to about one third of its peak, which was reached when the KSE-100 touched roughly 189,000 points.

fact_text: The analyst attributes the recent market fall to the Persian Gulf conflict and oil supply worries, together with the State Bank's decision not to cut interest rates.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 06 Mar 2026 | KSE-100 Falls | Leverage Declining | Fatima | Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-03-06)

fact_text: Industries Minister Ali Pervaiz said an energy conservation plan is being prepared to cut petrol and diesel use, with work-from-home measures from 2020-21 as a precedent.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 06 Mar 2026 | KSE-100 Falls | Leverage Declining | Fatima | Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-03-06)

fact_text: The government is exploring alternate fuel supply from Oman refineries, and the analyst said a disruption in shipments from the Gulf would create supply problems.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 06 Mar 2026 | KSE-100 Falls | Leverage Declining | Fatima | Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-03-06)

fact_text: Synergy has been importing WTI crude for its refinery, which the analyst said is keeping its refined output running during the Gulf disruption.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 06 Mar 2026 | KSE-100 Falls | Leverage Declining | Fatima | Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-03-06)

fact_text: Qatar has declared force majeure on its RLNG exports, and the analyst said this has made gas supply a national debate in Pakistan.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 06 Mar 2026 | KSE-100 Falls | Leverage Declining | Fatima | Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-03-06)

fact_text: Industries already on the national grid pay roughly PKR 32 to 36 per kWh for electricity, which the analyst said leaves them better placed if gas supply tightens.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 06 Mar 2026 | KSE-100 Falls | Leverage Declining | Fatima | Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-03-06)

fact_text: The analyst said an LNG shortage would have little immediate effect on industry, because most industrial users have already moved to the national grid, but the effect could grow later.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 06 Mar 2026 | KSE-100 Falls | Leverage Declining | Fatima | Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2026-03-06)

fact_text: The State Bank of Pakistan's policy rate is 10.5%, and the analyst expects it to be held there at the March 2026 monetary policy decision rather than cut.

fact_text: The analyst said treasury yields point to a hold, and that keeping rates steady suits industry if policy aims to contract demand as the oil shock weighs on the economy.
